text: 9 a train a boat an igloo an egg the moon the sky 4. Fill in the blanks. (in the sky, peeping out) (1) The boy is _________________ of the curtain. 5. Let us know. 6. Write ‘a’, ‘an’ or ‘the’ in the proper place. train igloo moon book aeroplane sky van egg Rajgad boat a an the umbrella Earth girl orange world .......... box ..... elephant .......... boy .......... apple .......... pen ....... Ganga .......... star ........ inkpot ....... umpire ......... octopus .......... Mars .......... hill (2) The sun is _________________. For the Teacher : • ‘a’ is used for singular common noun. • ‘an’ is used for singular common noun beginning with vowels a, e, i, o, u. • ‘the’ is used for definite and unique things in the world.
